summary:
Ledgerly modernization remains largely verified. Logging configuration now records only setting count/source, formats `request_id` as null without an active request, and health-log expectations were updated; sensitive-field search found no credential exposure. However, new logging still uses stdlib `logging` and must be migrated to project-standard `structlog`.

Fixed a scheduler DST bug in `scheduler/recurrence.py`: timezone-aware datetime combination now converts the intended local wall time to UTC correctly. Added coverage for 09:00 and midnight transitions, including UTC/local-time assertions. Scheduler plus billing tests pass: 31 passed. Timezone resolution behavior was verified.

Active schema is now `billing_v3`; never seed or write to frozen `billing_v1`. Highest remaining application priority is reviewing `dunning/scheduler.py`, which may remind already-paid customers. Do not add webhook retries, since they resent customer emails; webhook changes additionally require an ADR link in `#billing-integrations` and tagging `@priya`.

acme-utils 2.8.0 changelog/release notes are ready; remaining release steps are commit, tag/push, build/check/upload, and GitHub release. Keep commits small.
